summary: @onereach/si-datepicker preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue datepicker component but ships an obfuscated npm preinstall script (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob using a custom string-array/shuffle obfuscator (opaque numeric array plus rotator function, _0x-prefixed symbol names, with-blocks under strict mode), whose actual behavior cannot be read from source. Executing an obfuscated blob under an alternate downloaded language runtime at npm install time is unrelated to a datepicker UI component and fires automatically on default `npm install`, granting arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at install time. The alternate-runtime choice (Bun executing math_init.js rather than Node) evades Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
